lead_editorial.title: Cyclone Arnab: 'zero loss of life' ka lakshya, asli imtihaan zameen par
lead_editorial.summary: Centre aur rajya sarkaaron ne Arnab se pehle badi taiyari dikhayi hai. Ab agle 36 ghante tay karenge ki yeh taiyari kaagaz par hai ya gaon-gaon tak pahunchi hai.
body: Cyclone Arnab ke 28 October ki subah Yanam ke paas Andhra coast paar karne ka anuman hai, aur IMD ke mutabik landfall par hawa 115–125 km/h tak, jhonke 140 km/h tak ho sakte hain. Isi beech Cabinet Secretary T V Somanathan ki adhyakshata mein National Crisis Management Committee ki baithak hui, jismein agencies ko 'zero loss of life' ka lakshya diya gaya. Army, Navy, Air Force aur Coast Guard ko standby par rakha gaya hai.

Yeh sahi disha hai. Odisha ne 1999 ke super cyclone ke baad jo sabak seekhe, unhone dikhaya ki samay par evacuation aur cyclone shelters hazaron jaanein bacha sakte hain. Andhra Pradesh ne lagbhag 5.7 lakh logon ko vulnerable maana hai aur Somvaar shaam se evacuation shuru karne ki baat kahi hai. Odisha ne paanch zilon mein school-college band kiye hain aur 300 se zyada response teams taiyar ki hain.

Lekin asli chunauti aakhri mile ki hai — machhuaare jo samundar mein hain, buzurg aur bimaar jo ghar chhodne se katrate hain, aur woh basti jahan alert ka SMS nahi pahunchta. 1 se 1.5 metre tak ka storm surge Kakinada, East Godavari aur Yanam ke nichle ilaakon ke liye khatra ban sakta hai. Yahan ek bhi chook bhaari padegi.

Hamari raay hai ki sarkaarein evacuation ke aankde nahi, nateeje dikhayein — har shelter mein khana, paani, dawa aur bijli ka backup ho, aur landfall ke baad bijli-sadak ki bahaali utni hi tezi se ho. Taiyari ki taareef tab hogi jab 29 October ki subah koi bura samachar na aaye.

stories.title: Cyclone Arnab: Andhra mein 5.7 lakh logon ki evacuation, Centre ne sena ko standby par rakha
stories.summary: 28 October ki subah Yanam ke paas landfall ka anuman; NCMC baithak mein 'zero loss of life' ka lakshya, Odisha ke paanch zilon mein school band.
body: Bay of Bengal mein bana Cyclone Arnab tez hota ja raha hai. NewsDrum ki report ke mutabik iske 28 October ki forenoon mein Bapatla aur Visakhapatnam ke beech, Yanam ke paas coast paar karne ka anuman hai. Landfall ke waqt sustained hawa 115–125 km/h aur jhonke 140 km/h tak ho sakte hain. 1 se 1.5 metre tak ke storm surge se Kakinada, East Godavari aur Yanam ke nichle ilaakon mein paani bharne ka khatra bataya gaya hai.

Somvaar ko Cabinet Secretary T V Somanathan ne National Crisis Management Committee ki baithak li, jismein Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Telangana, Chhattisgarh aur Puducherry ki taiyari dekhi gayi. Centre ne Army, Navy, Air Force aur Indian Coast Guard ko rescue aur relief ke liye standby par rakha hai. Andhra Pradesh ne lagbhag 5.7 lakh logon ko vulnerable ilaakon mein maana hai aur Somvaar shaam se evacuation shuru karne ki baat kahi; samundar mein gayi naavon ko waapas bulaya gaya hai.

Odisha mein paanch zilon ke school-college Mangalvaar aur Budhvaar ko band rahenge. Rajya ne 225 fire service, 60 ODRAF aur 17 NDRF teams samet lagbhag 302 response teams aur 100 se zyada rescue boats taiyar rakhi hain. Uttar aur madhya tatiya Andhra aur dakshini Odisha mein bhaari se ati bhaari baarish ka anuman hai.

stories.title: Kharge ki 'Modi ka baap bhi jayega' tippani par bavaal, BJP ka desh bhar mein pradarshan
stories.summary: Patna ke ek karyakram mein heckler ko diye jawab par BJP ne maafi maangi; Congress aur Tejashwi Yadav ne Kharge ka bachav kiya.
body: Ravivaar ko Patna mein Bihar ke pehle Mukhyamantri Shrikrishna Singh ki 139vi jayanti par hue karyakram mein Congress adhyaksh Mallikarjun Kharge SIR (electoral rolls ka Special Intensive Revision) par bol rahe the, tabhi audience se ek vyakti ne kaha ki Modi kahin nahi jayenge. Reports ke mutabik Kharge ne jawab diya, 'Modi ka baap bhi jayega.' Us vyakti ko venue se bahar le jaaya gaya.

BJP ne is tippani ko apmaanjanak bataya aur Kharge va Rahul Gandhi se maafi ki maang ki. NewsGram ke mutabik Amit Shah ne kaha ki Kharge ne maryada ki saari seemayein tod di hain, jabki BJP adhyaksh Nitin Nabin ne ise 'ideological bankruptcy' bataya. Somvaar ko Delhi mein Kharge ke ghar ke paas Rajaji Marg par, Patna, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Jammu aur Lucknow mein pradarshan hue; Patna mein Kharge ka putla jalaya gaya aur Bengaluru mein police ne kuch karyakartaon ko hirasat mein liya.

Congress media head Pawan Khera ka daawa hai ki pehle ek BJP karyakarta ne Kharge ke pita ka apmaan kiya tha — yeh daawa swatantra roop se confirm nahi hua hai, aur heckler ne khud kaha hai ki uski baat ko galat sandarbh mein liya gaya. RJD neta Tejashwi Yadav ne ANI se kaha ki NDA 'raai ka pahaad' bana rahi hai taaki apni naakamiyon se dhyaan hata sake.

editorial.title: Rajneeti ki bhasha girti hai, to asli mudde dab jaate hain
body: Kharge ki tippani bhale ek heckler ko diya gaya tatkaal jawab ho, lekin desh ke sabse puraane dal ke adhyaksh se zyada sanyam ki ummeed galat nahi. Doosri taraf, ek vaakya par desh bhar mein putle jalana bhi rajneeti ki usi giraavat ka hissa hai jiski shikaayat BJP kar rahi hai.

Sabse bada nuksaan yeh hai ki Kharge jis mudde par bol rahe the — electoral rolls ka SIR aur uspar uthe sawaal — woh charcha se gaayab ho gaya. Hamari raay mein dono pakshon ko 'baap' aur 'maafi' ki behas se nikal kar voter list ki paardarshita jaise sawaalon par jawab dena chahiye; janta wahi sunna chahti hai.

stories.title: Brazil: 80 saal ke Lula ne jeeta record chautha kaarykaal, Flavio Bolsonaro ne nateeje maanne se inkaar kiya
stories.summary: Runoff mein Lula ko 51% se zyada vote; pehle round mein peechhe rehkar runoff jeetne wale modern Brazil ke pehle ummeedwar bane.
body: Brazil ke President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ne Ravivaar ke runoff mein jeet darj kar record chautha (non-consecutive) kaarykaal haasil kiya. Al Jazeera ke mutabik 98.76% ballots ki ginti par Lula ko 51% se thoda zyada aur Flavio Bolsonaro ko lagbhag 48% vote mile. 4 October ke pehle round mein Flavio 47.03% ke saath 45.16% wale Lula se aage the.

Al Jazeera ke anusaar modern Brazilian itihaas mein koi aur ummeedwar pehle round mein doosre number par rehkar runoff nahi jeet paaya tha. Flavio Bolsonaro ne kaha ki chunav ke nateeje maanna 'asambhav' hai, aur unke court mein chunauti dene ki ummeed hai. Voting ke din kuch jagah polling do ghante badhayi gayi aur Minas Gerais mein 349 polling locations par bijli gayi, haalaanki machines battery backup par chalti raheen.

Federal Police paanch rajyon mein transport mein kathit rukawat ki jaanch kar rahi hai. Reuters ki ek report ka hawala dete hue Al Jazeera ne likha ki US State Department ke kuch adhikariyon ne Brazil par sanctions ke liye dabaav banaya tha.

stories.title: Serbia mein bada ulatfer: Vucic ne haar maani, student movement ki 'Student List' ko bahumat
stories.summary: Vucic ke anumaan se Student List ko 250 mein se 135–140 seats; turnout 1992 ke baad sabse zyada.
body: Serbia ke snap parliamentary election mein Aleksandar Vucic ne haar sweekar kar li hai. Al Jazeera ke mutabik unhone kaha ki saaf hai 'hum yeh chunav haar gaye hain', haalaanki final nateeje abhi aane baaki the. Vote sample ke aadhaar par Vucic ne anumaan diya ki Student List ko 250 mein se 135–140 seats aur unki list ko lagbhag 105 seats milengi; bahumat ke liye 126 chahiye.

State Election Commission ke anusaar shaam 6 baje tak turnout 64.9% tha — 1992 mein Yugoslavia ke bikharne ke baad sabse zyada. Yeh andolan November 2024 mein Novi Sad railway station ki canopy girne se 16 logon ki maut ke baad shuru hua tha aur bhrashtachar ke aaropon ke khilaaf mohim ban gaya; Vucic aur unki party in aaropon se inkaar karti hai.

Vucic ki Serbian Progressive Party 2012 se satta mein thi. Unhone September mein President pad se istifa dekar Prime Minister ke liye chunav lada tha. Election watchdog CRTA ne monitor kiye gaye lagbhag ek-tihaai polling stations par voters ya karmchariyon par dabaav ki shikaayat darj ki.

sources.name: Euronews — Student List wins Serbian election

editorial.title: Belgrade se Brasilia tak: ballot ki taaqat abhi zinda hai
body: Ek hi weekend mein do bilkul alag kahaniyan — Serbia mein lambe samay se satta mein baithe neta ne students ke andolan se haar maani, aur Brazil mein 80 saal ke Lula ne pehle round mein peechhe rehkar wapasi ki. Dono jagah voter ne saabit kiya ki nateeja pehle se tay nahi hota.

Lekin farq bhi dekhne layak hai. Vucic ne sample results par hi haar sweekar kar li, jabki Brazil mein haarne wale paksh ne nateejon ko maanne se inkaar kiya. Hamari raay mein loktantra sirf chunav jeetne se nahi, haar ko shaanti se sweekar karne se bhi majboot hota hai — aur yeh sabak har desh ke liye hai.

stories.title: Din ke nichle star se 1,000 points ki wapasi: Sensex 483 uchhla, Nifty 22,753 par band
stories.summary: Metal aur pharma shares ne bazaar ko sambhaala; mehnga crude aur Fed meeting se pehle saavdhani ne badhat seemit rakhi.
body: Kamzor shuruaat ke baad Somvaar ko bazaar ne zordaar wapasi ki. Sensex 482.92 points (0.66%) chadhkar 73,606.75 aur Nifty 50 153.20 points (0.68%) badhkar 22,753.20 par band hua. DSIJ ke mutabik din mein Sensex 72,514 tak gir gaya tha, yaani nichle star se 1,000 se zyada points ki recovery hui. Midcap 100 1.19% aur smallcap index lagbhag 1.38% upar rahe.

Metal sector sabse aage raha, pharma aur healthcare mein bhi kharidari dikhi. Results ke baad Dr. Reddy's aur Kotak Mahindra Bank chamke, jabki HDFC Bank, Bajaj Finance aur Shriram Finance ne dabaav banaya. Kotak Neo ke mutabik dopahar baad Brent December futures lagbhag $110 prati barrel par the, jo pichhle hafte ke chhe mahine ke uchch star ke kareeb se thoda neeche aaye.

Analysts ke mutabik value buying ne recovery ko support kiya, lekin mehnga crude, geopolitical tanaav aur 27–28 October ki US Fed meeting samet ECB aur BoJ ke faislon se pehle ki saavdhani ne badhat ko seemit rakha. (Yeh khabar sirf jaankari ke liye hai, nivesh salaah nahi.)

stories.title: Ather Energy Q2 mein munafe mein aayi, revenue 63% badha
stories.summary: September quarter mein lagbhag ₹1.3 crore ka net profit, pichhle saal isi quarter mein ₹154 crore ka ghaata tha.
body: Electric two-wheeler company Ather Energy ne July–September quarter (Q2 FY27) mein lagbhag ₹1.3 crore ka consolidated net profit darj kiya. Inc42 ke mutabik pichhle saal isi quarter mein company ko ₹154.1 crore aur June quarter mein ₹51.1 crore ka ghaata hua tha.

Operating revenue saal-dar-saal 62.9% badhkar ₹1,464.2 crore ho gaya. Kharche 39.4% badhe, yaani revenue se dheemi raftaar se. Report ke mutabik ₹62.7 crore ki 'other income' munafe ke liye ahem rahi, kyunki operating revenue kul kharchon se kam tha.

Results ke baad Somvaar ko Ather ke shares intraday mein 17.6% tak uchhal kar ₹1,623 tak pahunche, Business Standard ne bataya. Company Hosur aur nayi Factory 3.0 mein capacity badhane ki yojana par kaam kar rahi hai.

editorial.title: Bazaar ki wapasi achhi, par crude ka saaya abhi hata nahi
body: Ek din mein 1,000 points ki recovery dikhati hai ki niche ke staron par kharidaar maujood hain, aur Q2 ke shuruaati results — khaaskar metals, power aur pharma mein — kuch sahara de rahe hain. Ather jaise naye zamane ki companiyon ka munafe mein aana bhi achhi khabar hai.

Lekin $110 ke aaspaas ka Brent aur duniya bhar ke central banks ke faisle abhi bhi bade jokhim hain. Hamari raay mein ek achhe din ko trend maanna jaldbaazi hogi; asli tasveer tab saaf hogi jab tel ki keemat aur Fed ka rukh dono saamne aa jaayenge.

stories.title: French Open final mein Sindhu ne pehla game jeeta, par An Se Young se haari
stories.summary: World No. 1 An Se Young ne 16-21, 21-11, 21-12 se jeet kar chautha French Open title liya; Sindhu ne kaha, match se 'kaafi positives' mile.
body: Do baar ki Olympic medallist PV Sindhu Ravivaar ko French Open Super 750 ke women's singles final mein South Korea ki An Se Young se haar gayin. PTI ke mutabik Sindhu ne pehla game 21-16 se jeeta, lekin An ne agle do game 21-11, 21-12 se apne naam kiye.

Report ke anusaar 31 saal ki Sindhu ne An ke khilaaf apne career mein sirf doosri baar koi game jeeta; is match se pehle woh 11 mukablon mein An ko kabhi nahi hara payi thin. World No. 1 aur Olympic champion An ka yeh chautha French Open title aur 2026 ka 11va khitaab hai.
Sindhu ne kaha ki unhone 'har point ke liye sangharsh kiya' aur maana ki decider mein 8-5 ki badhat bachaani chahiye thi. Unke mutabik is match se kaafi positives mile hain.

sources.name: The Bridge (PTI) — Sindhu French Open final

stories.title: Drishyam 3 ka chautha Ravivaar bhi dum-daar, worldwide kamaai ₹572 crore ke paar
stories.summary: Day 24 par ₹3 crore net, Shanivaar se 13% zyada; India net collection ₹368.9 crore.
body: Ajay Devgn aur Tabu starrer 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' ne apne chauthe Ravivaar (Day 24) ko India mein lagbhag ₹3 crore net kamaaye, jo Shanivaar ke ₹2.65 crore se 13.2% zyada hai. Yeh aankde NewsBytes ki report par aadharit hain.
Report ke mutabik film ka India net collection ₹368.9 crore aur India gross ₹441.9 crore pahunch gaya hai. Overseas se ₹130.5 crore ke saath worldwide gross lagbhag ₹572.4 crore ho gaya hai.

stories.title: Rajinikanth ki 'Dharman' mein Nayanthara ki entry, Pongal 2027 par release ki taiyari
stories.summary: Ashwath Marimuthu ki film ko Kamal Haasan produce kar rahe hain; makers ne silhouette poster ke saath Nayanthara ka swagat kiya.
body: Rajinikanth ki aane wali Tamil action-entertainer 'Dharman' mein Nayanthara special appearance mein dikhengi. Bollywood Hungama ke mutabik makers ne 25 October ko ek poster jaari kiya jismein dono kalakaar parchhaiyon (silhouettes) mein dikh rahe hain. Unke kirdaar ke baare mein abhi koi jaankari nahi di gayi hai.

Film ko 'Oh My Kadavule' aur 'Dragon' fame Ashwath Marimuthu likh aur direct kar rahe hain, jabki Kamal Haasan aur R. Mahendran Raaj Kamal Films International ke banner tale ise produce kar rahe hain. Music Anirudh Ravichander ka hai, aur cast mein Simran, Raashii Khanna, Ram Pothineni aur Yogi Babu bhi hain. Film ko January 2027 mein Pongal ke aaspaas release karne ki yojana hai.

stories.title: Pune Police ne Google aur Apple se Rapido app hatane ko kaha, bina licence bike taxi chalane ka aarop
stories.summary: Rapido ki parent company par FIR; aggregator licence ki arzi August se pending hai.
body: Pune Police ne Google aur Apple ko chitthi likhkar Rapido ka app unke app stores se hatane ki maang ki hai. Inc42 ke mutabik Police Commissioner Amitesh Kumar ne Times of India se iski pushti ki. Police ka aarop hai ki Rapido shahar mein bina anumati bike taxi service chala rahi hai.

Rapido ki parent company Roppen Transportation Services ke khilaaf Vishrantwadi police station mein FIR darj hai. Report ke mutabik RTO ki jaanch mein ek inspector ne app se ride book ki aur paaya ki non-transport registration wale two-wheelers par paid rides di ja rahi thin. Company ne 11 August 2026 ko aggregator licence ke liye arzi di thi, jo abhi pending hai.
Pune ke collector Jitendra Dudi pehle hi licence milne tak bike taxi operations rokne ka nirdesh de chuke hain. Inc42 ke mutabik Rapido ki taraf se ab tak koi pratikriya nahi aayi hai.

sources.name: Inc42 — Pune Police vs Rapido app

editorial.title: Sindhu ki haar mein bhi umeed ki chamak
body: 11 mukablon mein jis khiladi se ek game bhi mushkil se mila ho, uske khilaaf final mein pehla game jeetna chhoti baat nahi. 31 saal ki umar mein Sindhu ka Super 750 final tak pahunchna dikhata hai ki unki bhookh abhi baaki hai.

Hamari raay mein ab zaroorat fitness aur decider ke dabaav ko sambhaalne par dhyaan dene ki hai — 8-5 ki badhat ganwana yahi bataata hai. Agar yeh sudhaar aaya, to An Se Young ka 'unbeatable' tag bhi tod pana namumkin nahi.
